verdict.rationale: Decagon's own voice product page says its voice agents are built for "multilingual conversations," so multilingual support is a documented capability. That is a single thin mention, limited to the voice channel. Nothing shows the agent answering in other languages from an English-only knowledge base. Missing for 10: evidence of multilingual support on chat and email, documented cross-lingual answering from an English-only knowledge base, a list of supported languages or depth of coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent supports customers in many languages, even where my knowledge base exists only in English

citations.quote: Voice AI agents built for natural, multilingual conversations and customized to your brand.
